statement: Grok Build's pinned file-event utilities write versioned session events as append-oriented JSONL, while an event tracker emits turn, tool, permission, and terminal lifecycle records with stable typed payloads.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Grok Build file-event utility 以 append-oriented JSONL 写入带版本的 session event；event tracker 则发送 turn、tool、permission 与 terminal 生命周期记录，并使用稳定的 typed payload。
display_text.en: Grok Build's pinned file-event utilities write versioned session events as append-oriented JSONL, and the tracker emits typed turn, tool, permission, and terminal lifecycle records.

evidence.title: Grok Build event tracker
evidence.locator: turn, tool, permission, and terminal event emission

notes: Source-visible append behavior does not establish deployment-wide retention, durability, or redaction policy.
